'''NK Dugopolje''' is a [[Football in Croatia|Croatian]] professional [[association football|football]] club based in the town of [[Dugopolje]] on the outskirts of [[Split (city)|Split]], a city on the [[Adriatic]] coast. They were founded in 1952, and they currently play in the [[Prva nogometna liga]] (English: First football league), commonly '''Prva NL''' or '''1. NL''', is the second tier of the [[Croatian football league system|football league system]] in [[Croatia]]."}}
